bias.en: Rebound · reclaimed the 5 and 10-day, capped at the 200-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 5 日和 10 日均线，受制于 200 日均线

read.en: Bloom Energy jumped 9.0% on Nov 3 to $214.01, trading between $208.20 and $220.50. It is just above the falling 5-day ($212.8) and 10-day ($213.6), below the falling 30-day ($248.8) and 100-day ($244.8) and the rising 200-day ($221.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 8 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 28 ($192.31), and RSI is 44.
read.zh: Bloom Energy 11月3日大涨 9.0%，收于 $214.01，盘中区间 $208.20–220.50。股价略高于下行的 5 日（$212.8）和 10 日均线（$213.6），位于下行的 30 日（$248.8）、100 日均线（$244.8）和上行的 200 日均线（$221.9）下方。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月28日起看多（$192.31），RSI 为 44。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $210.1–210.9 highs and the 5 and 10-day; the $220.5 high reached the Oct 29 low ($219.0) and 200-day before fading. Resistance is $219.0–221.9, then $228.1–231.7 (Oct 28 close and high) and $244.8–248.8 (100 and 30-day). Support is $210.1–213.6, then $194.2–194.9 and $189–192.3 (Oct 23 low, SAR). A close above $221.9 would target $228–232; below $210, $194–195.

s.en: 5 and 10-day averages ($212.8–213.6); Nov 2 and Oct 26 highs ($210.1–210.9), reclaimed
